<h2>CDT Weekly Newsletter</h2><br><ul><li><p>UK AI Research Symposium 2026</p></li><li><p>Clocks go back on 25 October 2026</p></li><li><p>Engage with the Met Office Academic Partnership</p></li><li><p>Entrepreneurship Workshop</p></li><li><p>Bristol Doctoral College (BDC) Events and Opportunities &nbsp;&nbsp;</p></li><li><p>Bristol Data Week 2026: Recordings now available</p></li><li><p>Reminder: UK AI Research Symposium (UKAIRS 2026)</p></li><li><p>Transformative Sustainable AI Technologies &ndash; Funding Opportunity</p></li><li><p>Join the Data Ethics Club organising team</p></li><li><p>Data Ethics Club</p></li><li><p>AI CDT Lunch and Learn Seminar</p></li><li><p>EDI Hub+ Webinars</p></li></ul><p><p>Welcome to this week's issue of the newsletter.</p></p><br><br><b><p>UK AI Research Symposium 2026</p></b><br><div><strong>Call for Submissions &ndash; UK AI Research Symposium 2026</strong></div>
<div>The <a id="OWA065906c5-da03-dccb-8ca0-f1d663663898" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Home/Welcome" href="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Home/Welcome" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="2c1830cf-f0f0-4765-9b00-9ea36fb9b189" data-linkindex="3">UK AI&nbsp;Research Symposium (UKAIRS)</a>&nbsp;will be held this year in&nbsp;Edinburgh at the John McIntyre Conference Centre on <strong>24 - 25 November</strong>.</div>
<div>The Symposium will include themed parallel sessions, a presentation and Q&amp;A on AI &amp; Entrepreneurship, and a Community Panel chaired by <a id="OWA7fb9fd2b-d3f7-7045-89f3-2f9780ee4a82" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.linkedin.com/in/dawn-greenberg-3568b8bb/" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/dawn-greenberg-3568b8bb/" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="321a3d23-a02b-4a8c-9b09-f010b95d4dd8" data-linkindex="4">Dawn Greenberg</a>&nbsp;with panellists: <a id="OWA4341db12-c1f8-89ca-020d-74305bd2cdaa" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.turing.ac.uk/people/researchers/christopher-burr" href="https://www.turing.ac.uk/people/researchers/christopher-burr" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="98c73ece-37dc-4776-b73e-cc77660f5d8c" data-linkindex="5">Dr Christopher Burr</a>, <a id="OWAd5bbc198-a75a-d005-6d53-d4622f3cc96a" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://raeng.org.uk/about-us/staff-trustee-board-and-committees/academy-staff" href="https://raeng.org.uk/about-us/staff-trustee-board-and-committees/academy-staff" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="1ca4a9d7-74e9-410b-b313-65fd98e7ce5a" data-linkindex="6">Dr Natasha McCarthy</a>, <a id="OWAc782b452-e566-262f-c1bf-25c7024a92f4" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.turing.ac.uk/people/researchers/david-leslie" href="https://www.turing.ac.uk/people/researchers/david-leslie" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="25caab17-e3b5-4395-a5a1-8c429d2b4fe4" data-linkindex="7">Prof David Leslie</a>, and <a id="OWAb34a0d55-2013-8968-5352-bf8833129f3d" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.technomoralfutures.uk/our-people-and-staff/nayha-sethi" href="https://www.technomoralfutures.uk/our-people-and-staff/nayha-sethi" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="d8be066d-fed8-4ea5-a809-f3ddc7149048" data-linkindex="8">Dr Nayha Sethi</a>.</div>
<p>UKAIRS invites researchers, students, and practitioners to&nbsp;submit&nbsp;the following types of contributions:&nbsp;</p>
<p>- World Class Research Track (already published conference or journal paper): You will&nbsp;submit&nbsp;your peer-reviewed and published work (PDF).&nbsp;</p>
<p>- Emerging Research&nbsp;(2 page abstract): Research and early-stage research. You may propose a demo or a poster slot.</p>
<p><strong>Eligibility</strong><br>Students and researchers from institutions who have received or are eligible for <a id="OWA5c337c3f-9b7a-6cf5-2a82-8f338d2c71e3" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.ukri.org/publications/organisation-eligibility/research-organisations-eligible-for-ukri-funding/" href="https://www.ukri.org/publications/organisation-eligibility/research-organisations-eligible-for-ukri-funding/" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="011df50c-b295-46e6-8904-4c2daf8de830" data-linkindex="9">UKRI AI investments</a>&nbsp;(eg. all UK Universities)&nbsp;can submit under the World Class Research Track (already published conference or journal paper to present on) and/or&nbsp;Emerging Research Track (abstract for poster/demo).&nbsp;</p>
<p>For topics and submission details,&nbsp;go to: <a id="OWAc1a02801-05f4-00ed-74b5-6d2b56bc77fd" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/i/CallforSubmissions" href="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/i/CallforSubmissions" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-linkindex="10">www.ukairs.ac.uk/i/CallforSubmissions</a>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Important dates</strong>:</div>
<p>&middot;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;22 June 2026: Deadline for&nbsp;submitting&nbsp;papers,&nbsp;abstracts, posters, and demos</p>
<p>&middot;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;10 August 2026: Notification</p>
<p>&middot;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;13&nbsp;September: Early Registration Deadline</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>To&nbsp;submit</strong>, go to: <a id="OWA3e5a89ed-1f6d-294f-7ba8-ad177aa22531" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Submission" href="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Submission" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="8dc098e1-cc3e-47b6-81fe-01bbc4269b4b" data-linkindex="11">https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Submission</a>. If you have any questions, please contact &nbsp;<a id="OWAc85955ff-efe1-b956-51ce-2da8745d2c0c" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="mailto:APRIL@ed.ac.uk" href="mailto:APRIL@ed.ac.uk" data-outlook-id="e428c9d0-796d-452f-85f9-869126506540" data-linkindex="12">APRIL@ed.ac.uk</a>.</p>
<div><strong>Register here</strong>: <a id="OWA5a78c993-6bb6-032d-c564-53fd16dcb790" class="x_OWAAutoLink" title="https://www.efdelegates.ed.ac.uk/UKAIRS" href="https://www.efdelegates.ed.ac.uk/UKAIRS" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-linkindex="13">www.efdelegates.ed.ac.uk/UKAIRS</a></div><br><br><b><p>Clocks go back on 25 October 2026</p></b><br><p class="isSelectedEnd">A reminder that the clocks will go back one hour at 2am on 25 October, marking the official end of British Summer Time.</p>
<p>Please prepare emotionally for the sudden abundance of sleep and the confusion of wondering whether it&rsquo;s really the time you think it is!</p><br><br><b><p>Engage with the Met Office Academic Partnership</p></b><br><p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>27 October 2026, 1:00pm - 2:00pm, <a href="https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/358242248726947?p=BDrYPIBtTZfB0eMvE6">Online (Microsoft Teams)</a></strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Join Dann Mitchell and Rachel James from the School of Geographical Sciences for an introduction to the Met Office Academic Partnership. They will share updates on current collaborations and outline future opportunities to engage with the partnership.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The session will be particularly useful for those interested in working with the Met Office, with opportunities to learn more about potential routes for collaboration, including research and studentship opportunities.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The talk will be followed by a Q&amp;A.</p>
<p>If you have topics you would like to see covered in a future How-To Session, or would like to contribute to a session, please email <a href="mailto:cs-staff-enquiries@bristol.ac.uk">cs-staff-enquiries@bristol.ac.uk</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Entrepreneurship Workshop</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal"><strong>22 October, approx. 9:30am &ndash; 1:00pm, Room 3.18, 35 Berkeley Square</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal">Join SETsquared for a half-day workshop exploring how to turn research ideas into commercial opportunities. The session will cover the commercialisation process, intellectual property (IP), business planning and market research.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">You will learn about protecting and commercialising research, developing a value proposition, identifying potential customers and competitors, and evaluating market opportunities. Participants will also receive practical tools and resources, supporting materials, and access to advice from experienced mentors and legal specialists.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">The cost is &pound;120 with limited places available. The cost will be charged to your RTSG.</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">If you wish to attend, please <a href="https://app.onlinesurveys.jisc.ac.uk/s/engineering/sign-up-for-entrepreneurship-workshop">sign up using the online form</a> and </span><span style="color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext;"><a href="proai-cdt-admin@bristol.ac.uk">let us know</a></span><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">.</span></p><br><br><b><p>Bristol Doctoral College (BDC) Events and Opportunities &nbsp;&nbsp;</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">1. Catch up on keynote speeches, expert talks and panel discussions exploring how technology is shaping the world, including sessions on the Museum of Languages and Open Research in the Age of AI.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLbGLAY09PrM4">Watch the recordings here</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Reminder: UK AI Research Symposium (UKAIRS 2026)</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal">The <a title="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Home/Welcome" href="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Home/Welcome">UK AI&nbsp;Research Symposium (UKAIRS)</a>&nbsp;will be held this year in&nbsp;Edinburgh at the John McIntyre Conference Centre on <strong>24 - 25 November</strong>.<br>UKAIRS brings together the UK AI research community to showcase research, encourage collaboration and explore future directions for AI. The symposium welcomes students, researchers, industry partners and policymakers from a wide range of disciplines.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><a href="https://www.ukairs.ac.uk/Home/Welcome">Find out more about UKAIRS 2026</a> and <a href="https://www.efdelegates.ed.ac.uk/UKAIRS">register here</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Transformative Sustainable AI Technologies &ndash; Funding Opportunity</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal"><strong>Deadline: Tuesday 10 November 2026</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal">UKRI has launched a new funding opportunity for high-risk, speculative research with the potential to transform the sustainability of future AI systems. The opportunity is part of the UKRI IS8 AI Programme, delivered jointly by EPSRC and NERC, and aims to support the development of AI systems that are sustainable by design.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><a href="https://www.ukri.org/opportunity/transformative-sustainable-ai-technologies/">Find out more about the funding opportunity</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Join the Data Ethics Club organising team</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal">The Data Ethics Club is looking for new organisers from all AI CDT cohorts, as Huw Day and Jessica Woodgate will be stepping down soon.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">The club meets monthly to discuss the ethical use of data science, using papers, blog posts, books, podcasts and videos to spark discussion. It&rsquo;s a great opportunity for PhD students interested in ethics to get involved and help select reading materials and prepare discussion questions.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">Organisers share tasks including planning meetings, maintaining the website and GitHub repository, promoting sessions and writing up discussions. The commitment is around two hours per month, in addition to attending meetings. No special skills are needed, and tasks can be shared based on your interests.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">Interested in joining? Find out more about <a href="https://dataethicsclub.com/about/organising.html#get-involved">how the club is organised</a> or <a href="mailto:grp-ethicaldatascience@groups.bristol.ac.uk">email the team</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Data Ethics Club</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;"><span style="mso-bidi-font-weight: bold;">26 November 2026, online (Zoom), 1 - 2pm</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The next meeting of the Data Ethics Club will take place on 26 November. There is no need to register, just pop in!</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">For more information about the club and upcoming discussions, see <a href="https://dataethicsclub.com/join_in/join_in.html"><strong><span style="color: #0000ee;">Data</span></strong></a><a href="https://dataethicsclub.com/join_in/join_in.html"><strong><span style="color: #0000ee;"> </span></strong></a><a href="https://dataethicsclub.com/join_in/join_in.html"><strong><span style="color: #0000ee;">Ethics</span></strong></a><a href="https://dataethicsclub.com/join_in/join_in.html"><strong><span style="color: #0000ee;"> Club.</span></strong></a> <br style="mso-special-character: line-break;"><!-- [if !supportLineBreakNewLine]--><br style="mso-special-character: line-break;"><!--[endif]--></p><br><br><b><p>AI CDT Lunch and Learn Seminar</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><span style="mso-ascii-font-family: Aptos; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; border: none windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: none windowtext 0cm; padding: 0cm; background: white; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Please save the date for our next CDT AI Lunch and Learn Seminar as follows:</span></p>
